question: Pandit Ram Narayan a famous instrumentalist, is known for playing which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarangi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ram Narayan** is a renowned **instrumentalist**.
 
• He is known for playing the **Sarangi**, a traditional **Indian bowed string instrument**.
 
• **Narayan **is credited with **popularizing the sarangi** as a s**olo instrument** in **classical music**.
 
• He has made significant contributions to the development and recognition of the **sarangi internationally**.
 
• The awards received by **Pandit Ram Narayan**
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan** (2005)
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** (1964)
 
• **Padma Bhushan** (1991)
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship** (2009)
 
• **SNA Tagore Ratna** (2015)
 
• **Bharat Ratna Pandit Bhimsen Joshi Lifetime Achievement Award** (2014)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghatam**

 
 
• A percussion instrument originating from **South India**.
 
• **Made from clay**, usually with a **narrow mouth** at the top and a **wide base**.
 
• **Played by striking** the outer surface with the **fingers, palms, and sometimes with a stick**.
 
• Produces a **variety of tones **depending on where it is** struck** and the **force applied**.
 
• Often used in **Carnatic music concerts** and **accompanies dance performances**.
 
 
 
• **Veena**'
 
 
• A traditional **Indian string instrument**.
 
• Comes in various forms such as the **Saraswati veena**, **Rudra veena**, and **Vichitra veena**.
 
• Prominent in **Indian classical music**, particularly in **Carnatic and Hindustani traditions**.
 
• Often associated with the **Hindu goddess Saraswati**, the deity of **knowledge, arts, and music**.
 
 
 
• **Sarod**
 
 
• A fretless string instrument from the **Indian subcontinent**.
 
• Typically has **four to six main strings **and a number of **sympathetic strings**.
 
• Integral to **Hindustani classical music **and also used in some forms of **folk and fusion music**.
 
• Prominent performers include **Ali Akbar Khan**, **Amjad Ali Khan**, and **Buddhadev Das Gupta**.
